Hyperledger Solang is an actively maintained Solidity-to-WASM compiler (Apache-2.0) with a Stellar/Soroban target as first-class output, not a tutorial or product app. The Stellar docs and stellar-cli treat it as the supported Solidity compiler for smart contracts on Stellar; recent 0.3.4 (Feb 2026) still ships stellar-sdk and stellar examples.
Consulting-Manao/tansu is a live Stellar/Soroban dApp (DAO/governance product) with recent commits, a working site, and product-level code — not an official SDK and not a starter template.
